lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to set his face against Mount Seir and make its cities ruins.
Mount Seir harbored an ancient hatred and handed the Israelites over to famine, so bloodshed will pursue it.
God heard every contemptuous word Seir spoke against Israel's mountains, and all of Edom will become a desolation.
God tells Ezekiel to prophesy to Israel's mountains and swears the surrounding nations will endure reproach of their own.
Israel's mountains will bear fruit, be tilled and sown, and see ruins rebuilt as God multiplies people and animals.
